summary: Phase 1 content verifies and the phase changed no file under apps/. Tasks 1.1 to 1.4 carry [x] with resolving SHAs. baseline.json, classification.md and the second-check chain all match each other and the runner log. One procedural blocker stands. test-strategy.md requires a bounded adversarial pass for Phase 1, and no adversarial result names Phase 1. The two Phase 1 rows that later proved wrong are the case in point. Run that pass at the current HEAD and rerun this acceptance, or record a PM exception.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: Phase 1 has no adversarial result. test-strategy.md sections 2 and 3 mark the Phase 1 adversarial pass as 'yes, bounded'. The section 7 closeout gate orders Review A, the bounded adversarial pass, then phase acceptance. All 15 adversarial-*.json files name Phase 2, 3 or 4. The earliest, adversarial-2be9b74.json, audits Phase 2. Rationale: the required pass targets a mislabeled K row and a duplicate that keeps no rule. Two Phase 1 rows were wrong and passed a second-check sample. They are the D4 navigation row (plan task 4.12, F50, restored in 9eb3b9c4f) and the D2 explicit-English row (F51, restored in fb5622ed7). Fix: run measure-adversarial-testing for Phase 1 at the current HEAD, then rerun this acceptance. Or record a PM exception for this gap. Mitigation: adversarial-bfda22b.json passed the section 8 attack cases on the K list and on the e2e rows, and the seven tutor-commission K files stay unchanged.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The second check agreed with two rows that Phase 2 later proved wrong. The round 1 sample agreed with the D2 explicit-English row. The 1d4ddd2 sample agreed with the D4 navigation row. Counting the navigation miss, the rate is 4 of 37 (10.8 %), under the 15 % stop rule. classification.md still lists both rows as delete. Plan task 4.12 and report.md record the restores. No fix is needed beyond F1.

N2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: No Phase 1 artifact records the route of the classifier. The plan requires a second check by a different model family. All three second checks ran on openai/gpt-6-luna#high. The spec author was the Muse family. The record cannot show the classifier family. The orchestrator dispatch record holds it.

N3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Plan task 1.3 says 'Rate in the log.' The final log second-check-d1b9d59.log gives no number. The rate sits in the JSON field disagreement_rate_rows and in second-check-1d4ddd2.log. The final pass reused the 37-row sample and drew no new one. The diff 1d4ddd2c0..d1b9d597b changed only D1 rows, the counting-rule paragraph, the summary and the projection, so no unsampled class changed.
